reason: I've already got two clients I think are taking the mick, and a free audit with a DPA and UK hosting costs me 45 minutes, so I'll take it. Whether I pay £240 a month afterwards depends entirely on whether the number it finds is real money I'd actually bill, not goodwill I've chosen to give.
objection: Most of what it flags will be free work I do on purpose to keep clients sweet, and I already know about it. If the report is mostly that, it's telling me what I know, and a monthly check isn't worth £2,880 a year.
would_change_my_mind: If the audit turns up less than about £5k a year of genuinely billable money I didn't already know about, I won't subscribe after the free 30 days.
